sense_label: the part of your head you hear with

teaching.definition_en: The part on the side of your head that you hear with.
teaching.explanation_vi: Bộ phận ở hai bên đầu dùng để nghe (cái tai).

sense_label: a round food from a hen

sense_label: a very big animal with a long nose

teaching.definition_en: A very big grey animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk.
teaching.explanation_vi: Con vật rất to, màu xám, tai to và có cái vòi dài (con voi).
